## A section heading describing the trend over time

Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore.
The chart below uses **synthetic placeholder data**, not real regional figures.

```{python}
#| label: fig-line
#| fig-cap: "A caption describing what this line chart would show"
import random
from itertools import accumulate
import plotly.graph_objects as go

random.seed(1)
steps = [20] + [random.gauss(4, 6) for _ in range(11)]  # synthetic series — not real data
line_values = list(accumulate(steps))

fig = go.Figure(go.Scatter(x=list(range(1, 13)), y=line_values,
                           mode="lines+markers",
                           line=dict(color=accent_dark, width=3),
                           marker=dict(color=accent_dark, size=7)))
zola_style(fig, ytitle="A measured value", xtitle="Time period")
```
